question: Do fixed 1s and 2s read-only execution snapshots visibly separate later strict PASS/FAIL in a small frozen-baseline cohort?
snapshot_rule: exact controller trace tick before endpoint; no interpolation, no endpoint substitution
feature_derivation: read existing RobotState and immutable node/local/reference frames; baseline correction delta is applied minus nominal and expected zero
trend: fixed 0-to-1s and 0-to-2s differences and per-second slopes for selected errors; no fitted window
run_order: for each case in selected_case_order: observer_off then observer_on
integrity_gate: before analysis require exact full-step applied-command stream, existing 0.1s trace rows, simulation step counts, node outcomes and final states to match off/on; require selected strict labels to match historical; stop at first failure
analysis: eight selected cells only; report 0/1/2s class ranges and paired case comparisons, velocity versus fixed short trend, early versus later node patterns, and fixed strict-limit descriptive rule at each time; no threshold fitting or generalization claim
fixed_rule: risk flag if abs(local lateral_m)>frozen strict lateral_drift_max_m OR abs(local heading_error_deg)>frozen strict heading_error_max_deg at that snapshot
stop_rule: stop after 14 frozen executions or immediately on equivalence/integrity failure; retain all partial evidence and do not add cases
